title: White hollow vessel
explanation: A minimalist white sculpture with organic curves and a hollow center, photographed dramatically against a dark background.
imagePrompt: Fine art studio photograph, vertical 3:4. A smooth white biomorphic ceramic sculpture with a hollow oval center, sitting on a pale plinth against a deep charcoal background. One spotlight, a long soft shadow, a little dust in the beam. No text, no logo, no people.
siteBrief: Reference: White hollow vessel. Family: Organic modern. Palette: chalk white, charcoal, warm gray shadow. Type: a small humanist sans, never outlined. Layout: one object with unequal margins and a caption under the frame, not a card. Motion: none. Carry these words into the page: ceramic, curve, studio, hollow form. Avoid terrazzo clichés, fake 3D blobs, pastel gradients, and props crowded at the base.

title: Lime stack, gold chain
explanation: Stacked lime slices on a cool gray ground, a fine gold chain, and one violet stone. The field around the object stays empty.
imagePrompt: Studio still life, vertical 3:4. A tall stack of fresh lime slices on a seamless cool gray background, a delicate gold chain draped over the top slice with a small violet gemstone pendant. Soft directional light, crisp texture, advertising restraint. No text, no logo, no people.
siteBrief: Reference: Lime stack, gold chain. Family: Quiet luxury. Palette: cool gray, gold, one violet accent, lime green only where the object is. Type: a high-contrast serif at a modest size, generous tracking on the small label. Layout: one object column and a wide empty field, type sitting far from the object. Motion: none, or a very slow settle. Carry these words into the page: gold, studio gray, still life, fine chain. Avoid glossy black luxury clichés, purple gradients, crowded product grids, and sale stickers.

title: Salmon, asparagus, dark plate
explanation: A dark plate of salmon and asparagus, lit so the glaze and the herbs carry the frame. The table falls away.
imagePrompt: Overhead cinematic food photograph, 4:3. A matte black plate on a dark wood table with a seared salmon fillet, charred asparagus, lemon cream, herbs, and a few edible flowers. Side light skimming texture, background falling toward black. No text, no logo, no hands.
siteBrief: Reference: Salmon, asparagus, dark plate. Family: Hero food cinematography. Palette: charcoal, bone, herb green, warm salmon, cream. Type: a sharp serif for the dish name and a small tracked sans for the ingredients. Layout: one plate large, caption tight underneath, no card grid competing with the food. Motion: still, or a slow steam. Carry these words into the page: plating, overhead, dark table, herbs. Avoid bright white tabletops, clip-art herbs, and centered logos on the plate.

title: Lime boots, mid-stride
explanation: Lime-green boots caught mid-stride on a crosswalk. The crop is the motion, and the color is the only loud thing in the frame.
imagePrompt: Daylight fashion photograph, vertical 3:4. A crop of legs mid-stride on a white zebra crosswalk, wearing vivid lime-green knee-high leather boots. Shutter fast, subject sharp, open sky, color left saturated. No readable text, no logos, face not in frame.
siteBrief: Reference: Lime boots, mid-stride. Family: Energy & movement. Palette: one loud lime against concrete, asphalt, and white paint. Type: a bold grotesque, tight leading, almost no italics. Layout: full-bleed crop with type in a quiet corner, not over the moving subject. Motion: the photograph already moves; do not add parallax. Carry these words into the page: motion, street, saturated color, crop. Avoid motion-blur clichés, lightning bolts, and gradient streaks.

title: Technical jacket, white sunglasses
explanation: A three-quarter portrait from chest to crown. Short dark hair, white angular sunglasses, a black technical hood, and a concrete wall.
imagePrompt: Black and white fashion editorial, vertical 3:4. Three-quarter portrait from chest to crown of a young woman with a short dark pixie cut, white angular sunglasses, and a large black technical hooded jacket with the collar up, against a raw concrete wall. High contrast, a little film grain. No text, no logo.
siteBrief: Reference: Technical jacket, white sunglasses. Family: Editorial fashion. Palette: black, white, concrete gray, one material highlight. Type: a fashion grotesque or a didone, used sparingly. Layout: image first, then a short credit line, no product-card chrome. Motion: still, like a printed page. Carry these words into the page: editorial, monochrome, outerwear, concrete. Avoid e-commerce ghost mannequins, cutout drop shadows, and ring-light portraits.

title: Freckles, blue eyes, dark lipstick
explanation: An extreme close crop: freckles, pale blue eyes, dark lipstick. The light is soft and the background is gone.
imagePrompt: Cinematic extreme close-up, square 1:1. An adult face from the nose through the lips and eyes, freckles across the nose, pale blue eyes into the lens, dark berry lipstick. Soft window light, shallow depth of field, fine skin texture. No text, no logo.
siteBrief: Reference: Freckles, blue eyes, dark lipstick. Family: Cinematic lighting. Palette: warm skin, cool shadow, one muted berry accent, almost no pure white. Type: a restrained serif for the headline and a neutral grotesque for everything else. Layout: a large crop with the subject off dead-center and a wide empty margin. Motion: still. If the page moves, only a slow light shift. Carry these words into the page: portrait, soft light, shallow focus, film still. Avoid flat even light, stock smiles, neon rims, and busy backgrounds.
